old_caption: The video captures a dramatic scene of a space shuttle external tank and solid rocket boosters undergoing a test firing. The camera is positioned to show the engines from a slightly elevated perspective, focusing on the base of the vehicle where the engines are located. The engines are large, cylindrical, and part of the launch vehicle assembly. The flame from their nozzles intensifies over time, casting a warm glow on the metallic surfaces of the shuttle and the structure. The visible '070' marking is present on the vehicle. The video highlights the raw energy and precision required in space shuttle engineering, showcasing the meticulous preparation and testing necessary before a launch.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a dramatic scene of a rocket engine undergoing a test firing. The camera is positioned at a low angle, focusing on the base of the rocket where the engines are located. The engines are large, cylindrical, and mounted on a sturdy platform. As the engines ignite, a bright orange flame erupts from their nozzles, accompanied by intense heat and sparks flying outward. The flames are so intense that they illuminate the surrounding area, casting a warm glow on the metallic surfaces of the rocket and the platform. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to observe the full intensity of the engine's power and the dynamic interplay between the flames and the sparks. The video highlights the raw energy and precision required in rocket engineering, showcasing the meticulous preparation and testing necessary before a launch.
caption: The video captures a steady, close-angle view of a Space Shuttle aft section during an ongoing static engine test. The white vehicle body fills the upper portion, with two large bell-shaped main-engine nozzles flanking a smaller dark central nozzle that remains unlit. Below the bells, an intense orange-yellow exhaust glow and bright horizontal arcs of illuminated spray churn continuously, while white steam billows across the lower half. A metal platform railing runs across the foreground, and a facility wall with ladders and mounted equipment boxes stands at the right, remaining in view with no visible translation or lift-off. As time advances, the left main-engine bell brightens from a dim orange throat toward a near-white illuminated disc, with the right bell also becoming brighter. The spray arcs and overall exhaust luminance surge and settle over time, indicating a pulsating firing already underway. The bright steam and spray continue to move beneath the glowing nozzles.
